SRC-246:R001.text: Restore a supported, evidence-correct verification lifecycle for an active externally owned project ticket, with SAI_WEBSITE T-31 as the real-world acceptance case

SRC-246:R002.text: HANDOFF_READY does not imply EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED: before any mutation, independently establish the canonical SAIPEN root and runtime identity, SAIPEN's own current admission, phase and ownership, the target SAI_WEBSITE root and its admission state, the relevant STOP, NO_GO and recovery-only restrictions, and the exact allowed mutation boundaries for both projects

SRC-246:R003.text: If mutation authorization is absent, perform read-only diagnosis and return BLOCKED with the authoritative reason

SRC-246:R004.text: Do not consume, preempt or impersonate the website ticket's execution seat

SRC-246:R005.text: Stage 1: on the actual SAIPEN source tree trace CLI command registration and dispatch, the verification execution API, active-ticket eligibility and ownership enforcement, regression-required evidence recording, evidence freshness and attempt selection, VERIFY-to-REVIEW prerequisites, conformance STALE_FAIL production, and Windows transport and supported evidence carriers; locate the exact implementation paths before editing

SRC-246:R006.text: Stage 1: determine which of the reported rejections are correct policy enforcement, missing runtime capability, incorrect evidence selection, invalid or incomplete machine evidence, or transport and invocation failures; do not classify every rejected command as a missing feature without first checking the supported API contract

SRC-246:R007.text: Stage 2: design and execute the smallest safe proof that an authorized owner of an active VERIFY ticket can provide trusted current verification evidence through a documented mechanism that preserves ownership, binds evidence to the correct ticket and attempt, identifies the actual verifier and outcome, preserves temporal and source provenance, distinguishes an intentional historical red test from the current green result, and does not accept an arbitrary checkpoint string as machine proof

SRC-246:R008.text: Prefer reuse of an existing verification executor or evidence recorder; do not introduce a second competing lifecycle engine

SRC-246:R009.text: Stage 3: correct the actual defect in the subsystem proven responsible and only there: restore a supported verification operation, correct an erroneous active-ticket eligibility rule, repair stale evidence selection, repair the verification-to-review transition, or repair a CLI-to-runtime dispatch mismatch

SRC-246:R010.text: Historical LOG events stay immutable: do not manufacture replacement events for E-339, E-341, E-344 or E-350; if a new machine verification is required, run it legitimately

SRC-246:R011.text: Stage 4 negative case 1: a historical FAIL must not override a newer trusted PASS for the same authorized verification boundary
